title: Tight Pivot-Turn Reps
description: Players practise spinning the chair around its own axis in a tight pivot, the turn used constantly to change facing direction without losing court position.

content.objective: Spin the chair tightly around its own axis without travelling away from the spot.
content.setup: Players space out with a marked spot each, enough room to spin freely.
instructions: Push one wheel forward and pull the other back at the same time to spin on the spot.
Complete a full 360-degree turn and stop facing the original direction.
Repeat the turn in the opposite direction.
Add a quick pivot-and-stop as if reacting to a pass arriving from behind.
coachingPoints: Keep the turn centred on the spot — drifting away from it means the turn isn't tight enough.
Use even, opposite pressure on both wheels for a clean spin.
Stay upright and balanced through the whole turn.
commonMistakes: Letting the chair drift several feet away from the starting spot.
Using only one wheel, which turns a pivot into a wide loop.
Losing balance and needing a hand on the floor to recover.
content.safety: Make sure neighbouring players have enough space to spin without colliding.
progressions: Add a ball in the lap and keep it secure through the spin.
